criteria.evidence: Diff inserts `## [0.10.4] - 2026-10-25` immediately above the existing `## [0.10.3] - 2026-08-27` heading.
Entry uses `### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Security`, `### Fixed`, `### Housekeeping`, `### Thanks`, matching the existing entries' headings.
Every bullet ends with one or more links of the form `[#2185](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/2185)`; no bullet lacks a PR link.

Replay stated 'No `gh` and no `origin` remote are reachable from here, so I built everything from git history' and reports all 37 PRs since the 0.10.3 commit are covered; final diff cites 37 distinct PR numbers.

Thanks section thanks @ChetanReddyC, @MuskanPaliwal, @Solarthis in the same sentence style as prior entries; turn 0 explained affiliation was judged by email domain and branch namespace with explicit reasoning for ambiguous contributors.

Security bullets state the change and the condition fixed (e.g. 'The OAuth token-exchange POST refuses cross-host redirects. Its body carries... so a 307/308 could send the token to another origin'); turn 1 removed attack narratives like 'malicious or compromised token-exchange endpoint' and 'prompt-injected investigate agent'. Some bullets retain illustrative examples (direnv `PATH_add`), which is borderline but describes the affected condition.

No 'malicious', 'attacker', 'exploit' or dramatizing wording remains; replay reports dropping 'waving through', 'train operators to accept reflexively' etc. Phrasing is mechanical ('a FIFO at `settings.json` blocked the settings read', 'force-deleted such branches with no merge check').

Turn 2 reply: 'Shortened every bullet across the whole 0.10.4 entry — all five sections', listing removed enumerations and asides; user then accepted Security bullets at their current length. Pre-turn-2 draft not directly observable, so judged from the replay's account.

judge.reason: The replay produced a complete 0.10.4 entry above 0.10.3 with Keep-a-Changelog sections, PR links on every bullet, all 37 local-history PRs covered with the remote-unreachable caveat stated, and a reasoned Thanks section; the Security bullets were rewritten to neutral, what-was-addressed phrasing. Doubt remains because the Security bullets are still long and include some illustrative consequence/example clauses, and the pre-shortening draft is not observable so c6 rests on the replay's own account plus the user's acceptance.
